sections.label: Head
sections.text:
Tearing pain in supra-orbital nerve, with
heat and throbbing pain in head and epiphora. Con-
fused, especially the occiput, with somnolence and a sort
of intoxication. Trembling in right upper lid. Coryza;
nose stopped, must breathe through mouth.

sections.label: Extremities
sections.text:
Tearing pains in hip-joints, femur,
and knee, especially left side.

sections.label: Relationship
sections.text:
Mclilotus, Antkoxanthum, Asperula,
and Tonga contain Coumarin, the active principle.
Compare them in hay- fever; also, TrtfoL; Napth.;
Sabad,
